crossRefs.note: As also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers…
But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and…
circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law…
concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and…
But this I confess to you, that after the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all…

translations.web: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
translations.bsb: They have known me for a long time and can testify, if they are willing, that I lived as a Pharisee, adhering to the strictest sect of our religion.
translations.kjv: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
translations.asv: having knowledge of me from the first, if they be willing to testify, that after the straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
